Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Take each redesign to the department head and the fortnightly Signal review for approval; L&D then signs off the final SOP.

2. Live dashboards with AI tools

* Own the live dashboards produced through AI tools and Zoho Analytics.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

3. Less manual work

* Find every manual report, Excel tracker and repeated hand-off in each department and replace it with a dashboard or an automatic summary.

* Formally retire the old report the day the new dashboard goes live, so teams do not run both.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

4. Rollout and adoption

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Role requirements

* Can read a Zoho CRM module (fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows) and explain what it does and where it breaks.

The Head of IT Data Governance reports to the Group Head of IT and Security and is accountable for the quality, consistency and usability of the data the IT function relies on to run and improve itself. This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. The IT leader accountable for a service remains accountable for the data supporting that service (e.g. the Head of IT Infrastructure and Networks owns infrastructure and identity data, the Head of IT Platforms owns platform and application data, etc.). This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. It works closely with the Enterprise Data lead to ensure alignment with enterprise governance, data quality, metadata and information management requirements.

The role develops IT-specific controls within the enterprise framework, measures compliance, reports performance and escalates non-compliance through agreed arrangements.

* Own delivery of the IT Data Programme end to end, including the traceability model, the roadmap and the implementation backlog that follows.

* Make sure the programme answers the business questions IT needs answered and doesn't become a documentation exercise. Every data requirement should be traced to a question and every gap to a prioritised action.

* Turn assessment findings into a sequenced backlog with named owners and see it through to completion.

Implement and operate the data governance framework

* Implement and operationalise the enterprise Data Governance Framework within IT. Support the nomination of named Data Owners, Stewards and Custodians across in-scope IT data domains, consistent with enterprise roles, responsibilities, standards and decision rights.

Oversee IT data quality, stewardship, compliance and remediation through the forum.

* Hold Data Owners to account for the quality of their domains and report non-compliance through appropriate escalations.

* Develop and maintain the IT domain-specific data definitions, metadata, reference data and lifecycle requirements in accordance with enterprise data standards established by the Enterprise Data team, working closely with Enterprise Architecture and relevant Data Owners.

* Govern alignment to the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model, ensuring the CMDB conforms to the enterprise IT data model rather than diverging from it.

* Apply the existing data standards that system integrations, platform changes and new tooling must meet before approval.

Data quality, measurement and remediation

* Implement the enterprise data quality framework across IT data domains, developing domain-specific rules, thresholds, controls and KPIs in collaboration with IT Data Owners and Stewards, consistent with enterprise data quality standards and reporting requirements.

The Subject Matter Expert – Security Operations Center (SOC) oversees advanced security monitoring and incident management activities within the Cyber Security function. This role serves as the primary escalation point for complex or high-severity security incidents, providing technical leadership and validation before handover to Incident Response teams.
  
  
The SME leads deep-dive investigations using SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, endpoint detection, and network telemetry, and applies frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND to strengthen threat-hunting and detection coverage. The role is responsible for designing, tuning, and validating detection rules, developing and maintaining SOC playbooks and runbooks, and ensuring effective monitoring across hybrid infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, and telco cloud).
  
  
In addition, the SME mentors SOC engineers, conducts trainings and technical workshops, drives automation opportunities (SOAR playbooks and workflows), and contributes to continuous improvement of SOC processes and content. The role also monitors threat intelligence, tracks emerging threats and vulnerabilities, and communicates findings through clear reports and presentations to security leadership and stakeholders. The SME may participate in RFP processes, providing technical input to help select best-fit security solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary contact for advanced security monitoring, threat detection, and investigation methodologies.
* Lead and supervise team members to ensure effective incident detection and response.
* Provide technical guidance and escalation support to SOC analysts for complex or high-severity incidents.
* Act as the final technical validation authority before escalating to Incident Response (IR) teams.
* Utilize the MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND frameworks to map detected threats and enhance threat-hunting capabilities.
* Lead in-depth analysis of security events from multiple sources, such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, endpoint detection tools, and network traffic data.
* Conduct deep-dive technical investigations for high-impact or ambiguous alerts.
* Identify gaps in detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Continuously support the content development team by recommending detection rule tuning to reduce false positives and by proposing new advanced correlation rules, behavioral detections, and anomaly-based use cases.
* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks and runbooks to ensure consistent investigation standards.
* Ensure effective detection and monitoring across hybrid environments, including on-premises, cloud, and telco cloud.
* Support SOC shift staff in maintaining SLA compliance.
* Review and quality-check investigation reports before closure.
* Participate in major incident calls as the SOC technical lead.
* Conduct post-incident detection gap analysis.
* Mentor analysts and organize trainings to maintain team expertise.
* Develop knowledge articles, technical documentation, and use-case libraries.
* Lead internal technical workshops and purple-team collaboration exercises.
* Monitor and analyze threat intelligence feeds, security blogs, and industry news to stay informed on emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
* Communicate findings through detailed, high-quality reports and presentations to security teams, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in the RFP process to provide technical recommendations and propose best-fit solutions.

* Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans.

* Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings.

* Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist, and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist.

* Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities.

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.

* Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.
* ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need.
* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.
* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience.
* Ten or more years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy.

* Middle East consultancy experience strongly preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

* Takes the decision on a clash rather than letting it circulate.
* Plans resource ahead of demand rather than reacting to a shortfall.
* Develops people deliberately, and is judged on their progression.

* On-time issue of the group's deliverables against the agreed programme.
* Model and drawing checklist failures found after the role's own validation.
* Clash resolution rate and the ageing of open clashes in the group.
* Utilisation and bench time across the group against the deployment plan.

**Job Description:**

**1. Job Purpose**
------------------

To carry out all surveying, setting-out verification, and dimensional control activities ensuring that the Contractor's setting-out, levels, alignments, and as-built records comply with the approved IFC drawings, project specifications, and the requirements of the Client and relevant Dubai authorities (DM, RTA, DEWA). The Land Surveyor provides the Resident Engineer with independent verification of all survey-related works and ensures full traceability to the Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) coordinate system and DMD (Dubai Municipality Datum) vertical datum.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

**2.1 Survey Control & Datum**

* Establish, verify, and maintain primary and secondary survey control networks on site, tied to DLTM and DMD via Dubai Municipality benchmarks.
* Carry out periodic verification of control stations to confirm stability and accuracy.
* Maintain the Project Control Register, including coordinates, elevations, descriptions, and check records.
* Verify the Contractor's survey control submissions and recommend approval to the Resident Engineer.

**2.2 Setting-Out Verification**

* Independently check the Contractor's setting-out of roads, bridges, tunnels, structures, drainage, and utility corridors against approved IFC drawings.
* Verify horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, cross-sections, super-elevation, gradients, and chainages.
* Sign off setting-out check sheets prior to commencement of works and maintain the setting-Out Register.
* Issue Survey Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where setting out does not comply with approved drawings or tolerances.

**2.3 Roadworks Surveying**

* Verify levels and lines for subgrade, subbase, aggregate base course (ABC), and asphalt layers (binder and wearing course).
* Check kerbs, gullies, channels, manhole covers, road markings, and signage positions.
* Confirm camber, crossfall, super-elevation transitions, and gradient compliance with approved geometric design.
* Carry out asphalt level checks before and after paving to verify thickness compliance.

**2.4 Bridges & Structures**

* Verify setting-out and levels for piles, pile caps, piers, abutments, bearings, girders, deck slabs, parapets, and expansion joints.
* Check geometric control of formwork, falsework, and reinforcement positioning.
* Carry out monitoring surveys for movement, settlement, and deflection of structures during and after construction.
* Verify final geometry of bridge decks, including camber, alignment, and joint positions.

**2.5 Tunnels**

* Verify tunnel alignment control, including horizontal and vertical setting-out of the tunnel axis.
* Check setting-out for segmental linings, cross-passages, shafts, portals, and tunnel finishes.
* Carry out convergence and settlement monitoring of tunnel sections and surrounding structures.
* Coordinate with the Contractor's tunnel survey team on TBM guidance and as-built tunnel geometry.

**2.6 Infrastructure Utilities**

* Verify setting-out of water, sewerage, irrigation, district cooling, telecom, and electrical networks.
* Check trench alignment, invert levels, gradients, and connection points to existing utilities.
* Confirm chamber, manhole, and valve positions and levels.
* Coordinate with DEWA, DM Sewerage, Etisalat/du, and Empower surveyors during joint surveys and tie-ins.

**2.7 Topographic & Pre-Construction Surveys**

* Witness and verify topographic surveys, pre-construction condition surveys, and existing utility surveys carried out by the Contractor.
* Check existing levels, ground conditions, and surface features against design assumptions.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design and existing site conditions to the Resident Engineer.

**2.8 Quantity Verification Support**

* Carry out joint surveys with the Contractor and Quantity Surveyor for measurement of earthworks (cut/fill), excavation, backfill, and pavement layers.
* Prepare cross-sections, longitudinal sections, and volume calculations using survey software (Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center).
* Support the Quantity Surveyor with survey-based quantity verification for interim payment applications.

**2.9 As-Built Surveys & Records**

* Verify the Contractor's as-built surveys for all completed works and ensure compliance with project specifications and DM/RTA submission requirements.
* Check accuracy, completeness, and format of as-built drawings prior to recommendation for approval.
* Maintain a comprehensive As-Built Survey Register and ensure traceability to hand over documentation.

**2.10 Instruments & Calibration**

* Maintain Consultant's survey instruments (Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, automatic and digital levels, prisms, and accessories) in good working order.
* Verify that all Contractor's survey instruments are calibrated by accredited laboratories with valid certificates.
* Maintain a Calibration Register for all survey equipment used on the project.

**2.11 Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive survey records: control sheets, setting out check sheets, level books, monitoring records, NCRs, and as-built data.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly survey activity reports for the Resident Engineer.
* Support authority audits and submissions to DM, RTA, and DEWA with verified survey data.

**2.12 Coordination & Reporting**

* Report directly to the Resident Engineer on all survey-related matters.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and team.
* Attend technical meetings, progress reviews, and joint surveys with authorities.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** B.Sc. in Surveying / Geomatics / Civil Engineering, or a recognized Diploma in Land Surveying with relevant professional experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum 10 years' experience in land surveying on construction projects, with at least 7 years on major infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, utilities) and a minimum of 3 years in the UAE/GCC.
* **Certifications:** Dubai Municipality / RTA approval as Land Surveyor is highly preferred.
* **Knowledge:** Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) projection, DMD vertical datum, DM and RTA survey specifications, geometric design standards, and infrastructure construction tolerances.
* **Skills:** Expert use of Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, digital levels, and 3D laser scanners. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D. Good technical report writing, attention to detail, and effective communication.

**4. Reporting Line**
---------------------

The Land Surveyor reports directly to the Resident Engineer and works in close coordination with the Assistant Resident Engineer, Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and survey team.

Skybound Wealth Management is a global financial advisory company with employees across the UK, USA, Switzerland, Cyprus, Spain, Portugal and UAE. We provide tailored financial advice to international connected individuals wherever they are in the world, supported by expert teams across wealth planning, tax, investment, compliance and operations.

**Department -** Finance (Revenue)

**Reports to -** Operations Finance Manager

**Location -** Dubai, UAE

**Contract -** Full-time, permanent

**Initial focus -** Adviser fee audit – expected vs received fees across all policies

**About the role**

Skybound looks after more than 6,000 clients with over £1b of assets under management. Fees come in from many product providers, each with its own pay frequency and, in some cases, product-level fee rules.

This role exists to make sure that for every policy, what we expected to receive is what we actually received. The adviser fee audit file is already built. Your job is to maintain it, monitor it every day, and chase providers, admin and the revenue team until every policy is 100% received or fully explained.

The role starts focused on the fee audit. As it matures, it is expected to grow into wider revenue and data work within Finance.

**Key responsibilities**

* Identify and prevent revenue leakage, ensuring all expected fee income is received in full and on time.
* Reconcile expected fees against provider statements across multiple providers, products and payment frequencies.
* Investigate variances and missed payments, working with product providers and internal teams to resolve them.
* Identify the root causes of recurring discrepancies and recommend process and system improvements.
* Maintain accurate revenue records and prepare regular reconciliation reports for management.

**Qualifications & experience**

* At least 2 years' experience in revenue assurance, reconciliation, credit control or a related role, ideally within financial services.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and investigative approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to engage external partners and internal stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership and the persistence to see issues through to resolution.
* Experience in wealth management or insurance is highly desirable. A degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field is an advantage, but not required.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

**Daily monitoring**

* Maintain the existing adviser fee audit file
* Monitor expected vs received fees for every policy, across providers, pay frequencies and product-level fee rules.
* Reconcile against provider fee statements and flag every gap.

**Chasing and resolution**

* Chase providers every day on missing, late or incorrect adviser charges, including where a provider system error means the charge is not being picked up.
* Chase assigned admin or respective adviser where adviser charge forms have not been sent to the provider, and follow through until the charge is set up and paid.
* Work every exception until all policies are 100% received or fully explained, so missed fees do not run on for months.
* Track each exception with a clear owner and next action.

**System fixes and revenue tagging**

* Where a missing or wrong fee is caused by an error in our own system, go in and fix it directly, rather than just reporting it.
* Where a system error keeps recurring, raise it with your manager and investigate the root cause, so it is fixed permanently rather than patched each time.
* Check that adviser fees received are recorded under the right revenue stream, so they are tagged as adviser fees when loaded to the system.
* Where the revenue team has recorded an adviser fee under the wrong revenue stream, correct it in the system.

**Reporting**

* Produce the regular fee audit output per adviser, and a firm-wide summary for senior management.
* Report % of policies received, value outstanding, value recovered, and open exceptions with actions.
* Flag recurring provider, admin or tagging issues early.

**Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* 2+ years in a reconciliation, revenue assurance or credit control role, ideally in financial services.
* Strong Excel: lookups, pivots, filters and working comfortably with large files.
* Strong initiative: spots problems and acts on them without waiting to be asked.
* Proactive and on top of things: owns the work day to day, keeps it moving and does not let anything slide.
* Curious and investigative: willing to dive into the detail to find the facts and the real reason behind an issue, not just the symptom.
* Confident chasing third parties and colleagues by email and phone, and following up until things are closed.
* High attention to detail and persistence: does not let an exception sit.
* Good communication skills, written and verbal, with providers, admin, advisers and senior management.

**Desirable**

* Experience with adviser fees or platform/provider statements in wealth management or insurance.
* Understanding of investment-linked and offshore products and different fee structures.
* An accounting or finance degree is an advantage, but not required.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

1. **Month 1:** Knows the audit file, the main providers, fee types and pay frequencies, and is running the daily checks.

2. **Month 3:** Every open exception has an owner and next action, and provider and admin chasing runs on a daily rhythm.

3. **Month 6:** Policies at or near 100% received or explained, missed fees caught within weeks rather than months, and tagging errors falling.

4. **Ongoing:** Consistently sends a regular update on the fee audit.

* Define safety standards and approval workflows for mainnet fault injection
* Design and drive routine chaos experiments:
* Daily patrol-level experiments: Low-risk experiments executed automatically on a daily/weekly basis
* Periodic validation experiments: Monthly/quarterly resilience verification of critical paths
* Large-scale drills: Cross-AZ / cross-region disaster recovery failover validation
* Establish a resilience scoring system to quantify system health based on experiment results
* Deliver improvement recommendations and drive business teams to remediate identified weaknesses

### \*A. Air Conditioning (AC) & HVAC Maintenance\*

1. Perform regular inspection and preventive maintenance of all split AC, package AC, central AC and HVAC systems.

2. Clean and replace AC filters as per the maintenance schedule.

3. Clean evaporator and condenser coils.

4. Inspect and clean AC drainage lines and drain trays to prevent water leakage.

5. Check refrigerant gas pressure and identify refrigerant leakage.

6. Inspect compressors, thermostats, fan motors and control systems.

7. Check AC cooling performance and maintain the required temperature.

8. Troubleshoot AC breakdowns, cooling problems and abnormal noise.

9. Inspect ducting, insulation, air diffusers and ventilation systems.

10. Monitor AC electricity consumption and report abnormal readings.

11. Coordinate with specialist AC contractors for major repairs and gas charging when required.

12. Maintain AC maintenance records for all branches.

### \*B. Electrical Maintenance\*

1. Inspect and maintain electrical distribution boards (DBs).

2. Repair electrical wiring, switches, sockets and lighting.

3. Troubleshoot electrical faults and power failures.

4. Inspect circuit breakers, isolators and electrical protection systems.

5. Support PAT testing and electrical safety inspections.

6. Monitor electrical load distribution.

7. Report electrical hazards and abnormalities.

### \*C. Mechanical & Kitchen Equipment Maintenance\*

1. Maintain commercial kitchen equipment.

2. Inspect refrigerators, freezers, chillers and cooling equipment.

3. Maintain pumps, motors and exhaust fans.

4. Inspect ventilation and fresh-air systems.

5. Troubleshoot mechanical breakdowns.

6. Coordinate specialist equipment repairs when required.

### \*D. Plumbing Maintenance\*

1. Repair water leakage and damaged pipes.

2. Maintain water pumps, valves and water supply systems.

3. Repair taps, sinks and washbasins.

4. Inspect drainage systems and clear blockages.

5. Maintain kitchen plumbing and sanitary fittings.

1. Follow daily, weekly and monthly maintenance schedules.

2. Attend maintenance complaints from all branches.

3. Respond to emergency maintenance requests.

4. Complete maintenance work orders within the agreed timeframe.

5. Identify recurring equipment problems.

6. Maintain records of maintenance activities.

7. Submit spare-parts and material requests to Procurement.

1. Follow company HSE policies and UAE safety requirements.

2. Use appropriate PPE.

3. Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.

4. Obtain Permit to Work (PTW) before controlled maintenance activities.

5. Follow safe refrigerant handling procedures.

* Build, lead and develop the project team including the Construction Manager, site engineers, planners, quantity surveyors, QA/QC and HSE staff.

* Set objectives, monitor performance and mentor staff to strengthen technical, commercial and managerial capability.

* Maintain high standards of professional conduct and integrity.

* Minimum 15 years in building construction with a main contractor, including at least 5 years as Project Manager with full accountability for programme, cost and contract on projects of AED 150 million or more in the UAE.

**Accountabilities**
As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.

+ Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.
+ Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain.
+ Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data.

+ Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships.

+ Manage the ingredient positive release program, including certificate of analysis (COA) reviews, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders.
+ Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to confirm materials meet quality and food safety specifications.
+ Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations.
+ Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and coordinate appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition.
+ Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to identify and mitigate emerging risks.

* Quality Systems & Document Control

+ Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions.
+ Establish standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archiving, and retention.
+ Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready.
+ Coordinate periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures reflect current practices and requirements.
+ Continuously improve quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency.

* Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement

+ Develop and manage supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks.
+ Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers.
+ Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.
+ Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance management, escalation, and disqualification decisions.
+ Provide leadership with visibility into supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and outstanding corrective actions.

The ideal candidate has 6–8+ years of Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality experience in the food and beverage industry, preferably within beverage manufacturing. You bring strong technical knowledge of food safety systems and supplier compliance, combined with the ability to manage investigations, audits, and corrective action programs. You are analytical, organized, and comfortable influencing external suppliers and internal stakeholders while managing competing priorities.
  
  

* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality within the food and beverage industry; beverage experience is preferred.
* 0–2 years of experience managing and developing technical team members.
* Demonstrated experience managing supplier qualification, approval, compliance, and risk assessment programs.
* Strong experience conducting supplier audits, managing quality investigations, and implementing CAPAs.
* Thorough knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including:

+ Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
+ HACCP and Preventive Controls.
+ Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) standards.
+ FDA and Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) requirements.

* Experience managing supplier onboarding, approval, and compliance documentation through platforms such as TraceGains, FoodLogiQ, or FoodChain ID, keeping certificates, audits, and specifications current and audit-ready.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analyzing quality data and supplier performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with strong attention to detail.

The Division Chief - Endocrinology reporting to the Executive Chair - Medicine provides clinical, education, research and executive management leadership in Endocrinology. The Division Chief is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in Endocrinology and integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery, specialized outpatient clinical services including diagnostic and therapeutic procedures for complex and complicated procedures, consultations and case management, and other associated clinical and academic activites. The Division Chief continues with personal clinical education and research activities albeit in a reduced and modified manner, and will have a full-time appointment to Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar and hold the position of Associate Professor or Professor of Pediatrics - Endocrinology.

**KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Takes decision related to budgeting and budget controlling mechanism for the Endocrinology Division
* Makes decisions impacting recruitment and management of staff in the division.
* Drives the strategic plan for the division and contributes towards the strategic plan of the department.
* Coaches, mentors and monitors staff performance.
* Supports and takes decisions related to educational, clinical & research activities of the Endocrinology Division.
* Identifies and articulates the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division of Endocrinology and collaborates on the implementation of strategies to achieve them.
* Leads clinical service planning, service development and capacity planning for the Outpatient/Inpatient activities of Endocrinology services.
* Promotes leadership and direction for the development of strategies to promote the recruitment, retention, and directs mission of excellence for the medical staff, and collaborates with the Division Chiefs to execute the strategies.
* Recommends clinical privileges, appointment, reappointment and corrective action for each member of the Division of Endocrinology as well as promoting mentorship and academic career development for these staff members.
* Responsible for all administrative activities of the Endocrinology Division unless otherwise provided for by the hospital, and serves on all requested committees including medical executive committee, and appointing such committees as necessary to conduct the function of the department.
* Develops and implements policies and procedures that guide support provision of services to the Endocrinology Clinic services.
* Continues surveillance of the professional performance of all individuals in the Endocrinology Division who have delineated clinical privileges, including performance, and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations (OPPE and FPPE).
* Continues surveillance of patient care and the professional performance of all individuals in the Endocrinology Division who have defined clinical privileges.
* Ensures that the staff of the Endocrinology Division provides services that are in compliance with all applicable standards and requirements of the Joint Commission International, Qatar Supreme Council of Health, and all other applicable regulatory bodies.
* Accountable for the financial performance and management of all budgets within the Endocrinology Division.
* Implements the clinical service strategies and business plan for the Endocrinology Division.
* Makes recommendations for the purchase of capital and other equipment and participates in the evaluation of products for use by different members of the Endocrinology Division to ensure their safety and efficacy.
* Sets and achieves targets to drive continuous assessment and improvement of the quality of care and services provided and initiates actions for necessary improvements according to Sidra Board initiatives.
* Works with the Chair - Pediatrics to establish and update the work week standards for all physicians and staff and assures that there is appropriate clinical coverage for all patients requiring medical care from the Endocrinology Division (including emergency care).
* Ensures all members of the Endocrinology Division optimize the use of electronic medical records.
* Sets and achieves targets for programs and procedures for confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with hospital policy and the privacy laws of the State of Qatar.
* In conjunction with the Clinical Service Chief, ensures the implementation of robust clinical governance structures and processes to ensure patient safety.
* In conjunction with the Chief Research Officer and division heads of research, ensures a program of clinical and translational research is developed and promoted and delivered within the Endocrinology Division.
* In conjunction with the Dean of Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar ensures there is an active and continuous program of undergraduate teaching within the Endocrinology Division to ensure an effective learning environment for students, residents, and medical staff.

* Ensures effective communication with and involvement of all staff within the Endocrinology Division in regards to key decisions and initiatives.
* Works collaboratively with other service chiefs, chief officers, and executive directors to achieve broad Sidra objectives.
* Conducts other duties as may be directed by the Chief Medical Officer and/or Chief Executive Officer.
* Initiates, implements and oversees programs designed to foster positive relations between Endocrinology physicians and the hospital operations and administration.
* Assists with marketing strategies to inform physicians and their staff of Sidra’s clinical diagnostic procedures, services and resources.

* Develops, manages and supports physician and community relationships, coordinating and disseminating information to all stakeholders to solicit ongoing support from the State of Qatar for Endocrinology.

**Education**

* Residency training in Pediatrics

* 5+ years in Academic leadership as section chief or chief of Endocrinology

* Maintain strong relationships with VIP guests and spa members.

* Promote employee engagement, teamwork, and a positive working environment.

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant to deliver both hands-on security operations and expert advisory services to the organization and its clients. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR/XDR, network security, identity security, cloud security, threat intelligence, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).

This role will support and strengthen security operations capabilities, lead complex security incidents and assessments, translate technical findings into clear business-focused recommendations, and work closely with clients, Infrastructure, Development, IT Operations, and management to reduce cyber risk, achieve regulatory compliance, and improve overall security maturity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SOC Operations & Security Monitoring:

· Support and, where required, lead day-to-day SOC operations, ensuring continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigation, escalation, and response.

· Design, establish, and maintain SOC processes, operating procedures, runbooks, escalation paths, and shift models for the organization and its clients.

· Monitor security events across endpoints, servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud environments, applications, and security appliances.

· Ensure security alerts are investigated within defined priorities and response targets, with appropriate evidence and documentation.

· Continuously improve SOC workflows to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and increase analyst efficiency.

2. SIEM, EDR/XDR & Security Tooling:

· Design, implement, and optimize SIEM operations, including log onboarding, normalization, correlation rules, dashboards, alerting, and retention.

· Configure and optimize EDR/XDR capabilities for endpoint detection, investigation, containment, and response.

· Ensure appropriate security telemetry is collected from firewalls, network devices, servers, applications, cloud platforms, identity services, and critical systems.

· Evaluate security tooling and provide vendor-neutral recommendations to improve detection, investigation, automation, and response capabilities.

· Develop and maintain security monitoring use cases aligned with business risks, threat intelligence, and emerging attack techniques.

3. Incident Response & Threat Management:

· Lead the investigation and response to high-severity cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, account compromise, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access.

· Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client representatives.

· Lead root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are identified, tracked, and completed.

· Develop, maintain, and facilitate testing of incident response plans, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

· Support digital forensics and evidence preservation activities, engaging specialist resources when required.

4. Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting:

· Establish threat intelligence processes to identify relevant threats, indicators of compromise, vulnerabilities, and attacker tactics.

· Lead proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and SIEM data sources.

· Develop and tune detection rules, correlation logic, queries, and use cases based on MITRE ATT&CK and observed threats.

· Translate threat intelligence into actionable monitoring, detection, and advisory recommendations.

· Track emerging threats and assess their potential impact on the organization's and clients' technology environments.

5. Vulnerability & Security Exposure Management:

· Coordinate vulnerability monitoring and remediation activities with Infrastructure, Systems, Network, Application, and Cloud teams.

· Review vulnerability findings, prioritize remediation based on risk, and monitor closure of critical and high-risk issues.

· Monitor external attack surface, exposed services, misconfigurations, and security weaknesses.

· Plan, scope, and support penetration testing, security assessments, and remediation validation activities.

6. Cloud, Network & Infrastructure Security:

· Provide security oversight and advisory across Azure, Google Cloud, on-premises data centers, enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, and identity environments.

· Demonstrate strong understanding of firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, network segmentation, DNS, secure remote access, and network traffic analysis.

· Monitor cloud security events, IAM activity, privileged access, configuration risks, and security controls.

· Recommend and support hardening, patching, segmentation, MFA, privileged access, and secure configuration baselines.

7. Cybersecurity Consultancy & Advisory Services:

· Act as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, providing expert guidance on security strategy, risk, and technology decisions.

· Lead consulting engagements end-to-end, including scoping, planning, stakeholder interviews, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and close-out.

· Develop cybersecurity strategies, target operating models, and multi-year security roadmaps aligned with business objectives.

· Translate complex technical findings into clear, prioritized, and business-focused recommendations for executives and technical teams.

· Manage engagement timelines, deliverables, quality, and client expectations to ensure successful outcomes.

8. Security Assessments & Maturity Reviews:

· Conduct cybersecurity maturity assessments, gap analyses, and control reviews against recognized frameworks and regulatory requirements.

· Perform security architecture reviews, configuration reviews, and SOC capability and readiness assessments.

· Assess cloud, network, identity, endpoint, and application security posture and identify improvement opportunities.

· Prepare high-quality assessment reports, risk registers, executive summaries, and remediation plans.

9. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC):

* Human Resources Department

**Technical Success Manager**

At Black Duck, we help organizations build secure, high-quality software by identifying and addressing security and quality risks throughout the software development lifecycle.

Our solutions are trusted by engineering, development and security teams around the world, including organizations operating in complex and highly regulated environments. We help our customers embed application security into the way they build software, enabling them to identify risk earlier, improve developer productivity and scale secure software development.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **Technical Success Manager** to join our Customer Success team in Saudi Arabia.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who brings together two strengths that don't always come in the same package: **deep technical credibility and strong customer relationship management**.

You'll own the customer relationship following the sale and work closely with engineering, development and security teams to ensure customers successfully adopt Black Duck and achieve measurable value from their investment.

You'll be comfortable discussing application security, the software development lifecycle and technologies such as **Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) and Software Composition Analysis (SCA)**. More importantly, your knowledge will come from practical, hands-on experience.

You'll be able to handle much of the technical work yourself, from configuration and tuning to product enablement and troubleshooting. When an issue requires deeper engineering expertise, custom development or specialist support, you'll know when and how to bring in the right technical resources.

At the same time, you'll be comfortable stepping away from the technical detail to lead executive conversations, develop account plans, run business reviews and build trusted, long-term customer relationships.

### **How We Think About Success: Align, Adopt, Amplify Value**

Our Technical Success Managers focus on three areas throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Align**

* Partner with customers and internal account teams to understand what success looks like and build a clear plan to achieve it.
* Translate customers' business objectives into technical requirements that engineering and security teams can act on.
* Build relationships with the right technical, operational and executive stakeholders to drive progress and remove barriers.

**Adopt**

* Drive adoption across customer teams, applications and use cases.
* Deliver technical enablement so customers have the knowledge and confidence to use the capabilities they've invested in.
* Help customers embed Black Duck into their development and security workflows, including CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
* Identify opportunities to introduce new capabilities and increase the value customers receive from the platform.

**Amplify Value**

* Continuously revisit what success means as customers' application security programs evolve.
* Use meaningful data to demonstrate impact, including adoption, coverage, risk reduction and security improvements.
* Lead business reviews that clearly communicate progress, outcomes and opportunities.
* Develop successful customers into advocates through references, case studies and broader customer engagement.

### **What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary technical Customer Success contact for a portfolio of customers in Saudi Arabia and the wider region as required.
* Own the customer success plan from post-sale onboarding through adoption, value realization and ongoing growth.
* Build strong relationships across engineering, development, DevOps, security and executive stakeholder groups.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance around configuration, tuning, integrations and product usage.
* Troubleshoot technical challenges directly, investigating issues and testing different approaches rather than relying solely on predefined solutions.
* Deliver product enablement, workshops and best-practice guidance to customer teams.
* Help customers integrate application security into their SDLC, CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.
* Partner with Customer Success Engineers and other technical specialists when issues require deeper engineering expertise or customized solutions.
* Monitor adoption and customer health, identifying risks early and developing plans to address them.
* Lead regular customer reviews that demonstrate measurable technical and business value.
* Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Support, Product and Engineering to deliver a consistent customer experience.
* Identify opportunities for customers to expand their use of Black Duck products and capabilities.

You don't need to come from a traditional Customer Success background. We're particularly interested in people who have built strong technical expertise and discovered that they enjoy working directly with customers.

You'll ideally bring:

* Strong hands-on experience within **Application Security, DevSecOps, software security or the broader software development lifecycle**.
* Practical experience with application security technologies such as **SAST, DAST and/or SCA**.
* Experience working with development environments, CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps tooling.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the curiosity to investigate technical problems where the answer isn't immediately obvious.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers in a technical, consultative capacity.
* The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both highly technical teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Strong relationship-management skills and the ability to build credibility over time.
* The ability to translate technical activity into measurable customer and business outcomes.
* A proactive, ownership-driven approach. You'll be comfortable trying to solve a problem yourself while recognizing when specialist expertise is required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience in roles such as **Technical Account Management, Customer Success Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Application Security, DevSecOps or Professional Services** could all provide a strong foundation for this position.

### **Why Black Duck?**

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of **application security, software development and customer success**.

You'll work with customers tackling real-world software security challenges and have the opportunity to influence how Black Duck becomes embedded within their development and security programs.

If you're technically hands-on, enjoy solving difficult problems, and get just as much satisfaction from building trusted customer relationships as you do from solving the technical challenge itself, we'd love to hear from you.

**Experience being part of a high-performing team with a fulfilling career in property management with FirstService Residential.**
FirstService Residential is seeking a proactive, people-focused Service Manager to lead operations across an assigned portfolio of condominium properties. This field-based leadership role oversees Front Desk, Housekeeping and Superintendent services, builds strong relationships with Property Managers, and supports engaged, high-performing teams. The successful candidate is organized, approachable and confident in taking ownership of service challenges and seeing solutions through.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
The duties below are representative of the position. Specific responsibilities may vary based on portfolio needs.
  
  
**Operations & Portfolio Management**

* Oversee service delivery across assigned properties, ensuring contract requirements, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and site-specific Standing Orders are followed.
* Maintain a consistent field presence through property visits, inspections and quality assurance reviews; address deficiencies and confirm follow-up.
* Identify operational risks, prioritize competing site needs and support property start-ups, takeovers and service transitions.
* Maintain operational readiness, including staffing, required documentation, supplies and equipment.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain positive, trusted relationships with Property Managers and other client representatives.
* Communicate proactively about service performance, staffing changes, concerns and improvement plans.
* Respond to client feedback promptly, resolve issues professionally and follow through on commitments.

**Associate Management**

* Lead, coach and support Front Desk, Housekeeping and Superintendent associates; promote accountability, engagement and professional development.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management and retention in partnership with Recruitment and Human Resources.
* Anticipate staffing needs and coordinate scheduling, coverage and cross-training to support consistent service.
* Oversee attendance, timekeeping, payroll approvals and responsible use of overtime and relief coverage.

**Training, Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Ensure associates receive appropriate orientation, site-specific training and ongoing coaching, with required records maintained.
* Monitor service quality and compliance with company policies, health and safety requirements and established procedures.
* Complete required inspections, audits and follow-up actions; work with Human Resources on associate matters within assigned responsibilities.

**Communication & Incident Response**

* Respond to operational issues and incidents, ensure appropriate documentation and timely escalation of significant concerns.
* Maintain accurate field activity reports and communicate portfolio priorities, risks and progress to the Director, Operations.
* Collaborate with internal support teams to resolve issues and improve service delivery.

**Additional Duties & Responsibilities**

* Uphold FirstService Residential Mission, Values, Global Service Standards and professional conduct expectations.
* Participate in meetings, training and operational improvement initiatives; perform other related duties as assigned.
* Provide temporary shift support when qualified and operationally required.

**Supervisory Responsibility**

* Front Desk, Housekeeping and Superintendent associates assigned to the portfolio.

**Education & Experience**

* Three (3) or more years of relevant leadership experience in hospitality, facilities, property operations or another service-oriented environment, including employee supervision.
* Experience coordinating staffing, service quality and client relationships; multi-site management experience is an asset.
* Condominium or residential property service experience is preferred, but not required.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong interpersonal skills, client service orientation and clear verbal and written communication.
* Sound judgement, initiative, organization, problem-solving and dependable follow-through.
* Ability to coach teams, navigate challenging conversations and manage multiple priorities.
* Comfort with Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel and willingness to learn scheduling, payroll and quality assurance systems.

**Travel**
Frequent travel to assigned properties and site offices is required.
  
  
**Physical Requirements / Working Environment**
This field-based role involves regular visits to condominium properties, walking and standing during inspections, and routine computer and phone use. Flexibility to respond to operational needs outside regular business hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  
  
**Compensation**
Compensation for this role is $50,000 to $65,000 + car allowance and benefits.

Women’s College Hospital (WCH) is seeking a dynamic, inspiring and visionary medical leader to lead the Department of Medicine and join the medical leadership team. **The Department of Medicine**

The Department of Medicine at WCH advances the practice and science of medicine through holistic, innovative, and interprofessional approaches to complex health conditions and distinctive models of specialized ambulatory care. The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.

The Department includes approximately 150 physician faculty members, including clinician teachers, educators, quality and innovation leaders, clinician investigators and clinician scientists. Its Specialized Medicine programs bring together nursing and health discipline professionals as well as clinical and academic administrative staff.

* Participate actively in WCH medical leadership.
* Grow existing and build new partnerships to advocate for and advance the goals of WCH beyond its walls.

* An individual experienced in interprofessional models of care and committed to interprofessional education and patient care.
* A person with a strong commitment to social justice, equity and the health of women, gender-diverse people and equity-seeking communities, both locally and globally.
* A person with demonstrated fiscal management and resource stewardship skills, with an emphasis on linking quality outcomes with optimizing costs.

**Job Purpose**
The Director, Technology Operations owns the operational health of the platforms Goway sells and services travel on: our reservations platform, the infrastructure it runs on, the supplier, air and distribution integrations it depends on, and the automation and data pipelines built around it.
  
  
This is a practice-building role. You will define and own Goway's technical operations discipline: service levels, incident management, change control, observability and operational readiness, and you will make them the standard across our technology organisation. You will work alongside other Technology leaders. You will own the technology operations of our platform. You will have the CTO's mandate and backing to build the practice.
  
  
**What will be your key responsibilities?**
Reliability and service management
  
  

* Define, publish and report service levels and service-level objectives for revenue-critical services, starting with quoting, booking, payment and traveller servicing.
* Own incident management end to end: severity definitions, escalation, incident command, communication during an incident, and post-incident review with corrective actions.
* Own RCA and problem management.
* Own change and release management as a company standard, balancing delivery throughput against change failure rate.
* Build observability sufficient to detect degradation.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity for platform services, tested and documented on a stated cadence.

Integration and supplier platform operations
  
  

* Monitoring of integration paths, error and failure-rate thresholds, and defined fallback behaviour when a partner degrades.
* Maintain a dependency map of the external platforms our revenue-generating flows rely on, with assessed operational risk and mitigation for each.
* Own operational readiness for new integrations and new product lines entering the platform.
* Own the operational reliability of automation and data pipelines in production.

Platform and cloud operations
  
  

* Day-to-day operation of the AWS and managed hosting infrastructure serving our platform estate: environments, provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
* Own hosting cost governance: visibility by service, a unit-cost measure, and an annual optimisation target.
* Lead capacity planning against forecast booking and travel volumes.
* Reduce manual, repeatable operational work through automation.
* Address seasonal capacity planning, change freezes and enhanced coverage aligned to our booking and departure peaks and to new product launches.

Vendors, partners and compliance
  
  

* Platform, hosting and integration partner relationships: SLA definition, enforcement and structured performance review.
* Reduce single points of dependency, whether on a vendor or an individual.
* Partner with security on vulnerability management, patch compliance, access control and audit readiness.

Practice leadership and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Build and maintain a multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned to Goway's growth plans.
* Report operational performance, risk and investment needs to the CTO and executive team in business terms.

* Evidence of having built operational practice where little existed: SLOs, incident management, change control and observability introduced from the ground up, with measurable improvement to show for it.

* Define security expectations for the design, development, acquisition, deployment, operation, and retirement of AI-enabled systems and supporting technology.

The Canadian Strategic Account Services (SAS) Core organization is seeking a Customer Success Manager to help shape the future of the program. The ideal candidate for this role should possess strong client management skills with the keen ability to work backwards with Sellers to identify and prioritize the right inputs and outputs to deliver value and growth. They will be able to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced work environment and surface program suggestions and areas of improvement to leadership. Above all, they should demonstrate a high level of ownership and the ability to embrace and navigate ambiguity and complexity. **Responsibilities**
Customer Success Managers are responsible for driving Seller business growth by providing customized insights and recommendations, educating selling partners regarding relevant tools, products, and services, and delivering a positive experience with our program. The key responsibilities of a Customer Success Manager include but are not limited to:
  
  
Business Growth
  
  

* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience. Identify what is hindering growth, assist with developing solutions, and testing.

Seller Relationship Management
  
  

* Build effective working relationships with your Sellers; be a trusted advisor and a business advocate.
* Deliver timely, accurate and professional operational support to all Sellers in your portfolio within a specified SLA.
* Drive optimal program and Customer Success Manager satisfaction.
* Work with other partner teams to assist cross-functionally to resolve Seller issues and questions quickly with high quality.

Program Process Excellence
  
  

* Improve team efficiency and optimize previously defined processes.
* Assist with the design of tools, standard operating procedures and processes of Seller Services.
* Work with manager to Identify, quantify, and define feature enhancements and new products to improve Amazon Canada product based on customer feedback, data analysis, and feature gaps with competitive products.

**Description**
*Position at Resolver*
Resolver operates as a hybrid workforce with a mix of both at home and in office work. For this role we are looking for someone who wants to hang out with us in real life 2 times per week with our awesome team.
  
  
As a Customer Success Manager at Resolver, you'll help customers turn their investment in our platform into results that matter to their business. You'll learn what their teams are trying to accomplish, build relationships with the people driving those goals, and help them make Resolver an effective part of how they work.
  
  
You'll have responsibility for a portfolio of customers and the opportunity to influence their experience throughout the relationship. That means helping customers adopt the platform, making their progress visible, addressing concerns early and recognizing where Resolver could support their next business priority. As part of our newly established Customer Success team, you’ll also have the opportunity to help shape the function, building out processes and playbooks as we create a dedicated focus on customer outcomes alongside our Account Management team.
  
  
Your success will come from combining customer understanding with business acumen. You'll know when to offer guidance, when to challenge an assumption and when to bring in a colleague with the expertise to help.
  
  
About Resolver:
  
  
Resolver is a high-growth SaaS company whose intuitive, no-code platform fives our customers a clear picture of their risks so they can make quick and effective decisions. As a part of the Resolver team, your work will help transform risk management to risk intelligence so organizations can protect people and assets and deliver on their purpose.
  
  
We are ambitious in both our mission and our culture. As a business within Kroll, we offer an innovative, non-hierarchical work environment blended with the stability and financial security of an enterprise. Resolver has also been named one of Canada's Great Places to Work six years in a row.
  
  
What you’ll be doing:
  
  
Customer Health and Value Realization (35%)
  
  
Measures of Success: You maintain actionable health assessments and customer-aligned success plans that guide progress.
  
  

* Build a working understanding of each customer's business priorities, stakeholders and expectations.
* Own the customer success plan, agreeing achievable milestones and evidence of value with the customer.
* Lead business reviews that help customers assess their progress and decide what deserves attention next. Build relationships with users, champions and executive sponsors so your understanding of the account extends beyond a single contact.
* Maintain evidence-based customer health assessments, facilitate feedback and follow through on what you learn. Use Salesforce to give the account team a useful, accurate picture of the relationship.

Retention and Risk Management (25%)
  
  
Measures of Success: You contribute to retaining existing customer revenue through proactive value, adoption and risk management.
  
  

* Identify concerns before they become renewal surprises. Understand how adoption gaps, stakeholder changes and unresolved issues affect the customer's confidence in Resolver.
* Bring the right people together around a recovery plan, maintain clear customer communication and follow through on commitments.
* Own renewal readiness across your portfolio. Ahead of each renewal, confirm the value customers are receiving, understand their priorities and renewal intentions, and address open concerns. Provide evidence-based renewal likelihood and risk inputs to the AM, who owns pricing, procurement, negotiation, signature and the commercial forecast. Support and Services retain ownership of technical resolution and delivery.

Expansion Opportunity Discovery (10%)
  
  
Measures of Success: You identify high-intent expansion opportunities that meet agreed qualification criteria, with a customer need, relevant stakeholders, potential value and an agreed next step for AM follow-up.
  
  

* Stay curious about the customer's changing business. Identify situations where additional products, teams or use cases could help them achieve a meaningful outcome.
* Explore the need, stakeholders and potential value before introducing an opportunity to the Account Manager. Make the handoff useful by sharing what you have learned and confirming an appropriate next step with the customer.
* Continue contributing customer context and value evidence while the Account Manager leads the sales process, proposal and negotiation.

Customer Advocacy (5%)
  
  
Measures of Success: You facilitate feedback and coordinate appropriate responses to customer concerns.
  
  

* Build relationships with customers who are willing to share their experience. Partner with Marketing on references, success stories and relevant customer programs.
* Represent customer feedback internally with enough business context for Product and other teams to understand the need. Keep customers informed about the response and next steps.

What you will bring:
  
  

* 2–5 years of relevant SaaS experience, ideally in customer success or solution delivery.
* Experience helping customers adopt software, achieve business goals and navigate challenges that affect the relationship.
* Confidence using customer data and CRM tools to manage a portfolio and prepare for meaningful customer conversations.
* Experience in Security and Investigations or GRC is a plus.

What we’ll give you in return:
  
  

* Health and Wellness Benefits: 100% paid by us for health, dental and vision from day 1!
* Professional development: we have an external learning budget to help you grow and develop. We host a learning workshop about every 6 weeks on topics like Time Management, Self-Awareness and Giving Feedback; we also have e-learning to meet the needs of our remote team. We offer career development opportunities to help you build your skillsets for internal growth opportunities and beyond. We also have a Coaching Program for all our managers. We know how important it is to have a good boss, so we invest in their development.
* Vacation: it's open, which means we don't worry about an accrual clock. On average, we see most folks enjoying between 3-4 weeks off a year
* RRSP: We'll match 100% of your contributions up to 2.5%
* Parental leave: Best-in-class top-up for new parents - 100% for 15 weeks new parents and 5 additional weeks of pregnancy leave for birth mothers.
* In The Office When you come into the office to work, you will have access to snacks and beverages and in-office games like ping-pong, group lunches, and karaoke. We also offer up lots of opportunity for team socials too, including the folks who are remote!

**About the Opportunity**

The best projects are won by the people who go on to build them.

A multi-billion-dollar civil program is coming to market in the Greater Toronto Area, and it will be delivered progressively. The team that wins it spends the first phase designing, estimating and scheduling alongside the owner, before a final price is set. Our client wants the Project Director who leads that pursuit to be the one who delivers it.

They are a national contractor with more than five decades of heavy civil work behind them, already a partner on some of the largest transit, bridge and energy programs in the country, with an Ontario business growing on the strength of that record. Big enough to pursue work at this scale; close-knit enough that the person leading it is known by name at the top.

You lead the pursuit from qualification and scored interviews through the development phase, then take the program into construction as its Project Director. You build and run the team, work with the owner and partners to settle design and price, and own safety, quality, cost and schedule from first shovel to handover.

**About You**

You have led major civil work where the commercial outcome rested with you, and you are at your best when you can shape a project from the front end.

The successful candidate will have the following:

* A career in heavy civil construction, including public realm work with Ontario Infrastructure owners
* Experience on design-build, progressive or P3 delivery, ideally carrying a project from pursuit through to close-out
* You bring constructability, sequencing and risk thinking into design while it can still change, and hold your own with owners, designers and partners at the same table
* Joint venture experience, where trust and influence carry as much weight as authority
* A sound read on ground and geotechnical risk, and what it means for cost and schedule
* Ready to put your name to a program people will rely on for generations

**About the Job**

* Continuity from bid to build: the strategy you set during pursuit is the one you deliver
* Real influence over design before the price is fixed
* Years of runway on the kind of program that defines a career
* A direct line to senior leadership, with decisions made close to the work
* The chance to assemble and develop the team that carries the program, as the Ontario business grows around it
* GTA-based, with competitive compensation, benefits and deliberate development
